sql.if: AND ( UPPER(WH_CD) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(WH_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH (WH_ID, WH_CD, WH_NM, WH_TP, USE_YN, REG_DT, MOD_DT) VALUES (SEQ_WH.NEXTVAL, #{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{warehouseType}, #{useYn}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
